# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Type Mismatch (Date/Num/Str) | 416-15, 560-12 | Agent writes `str` when `datetime` or `int/float` is expected, or vice versa. | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | CONTRACT |
| 2 | Blast Radius / Untouched Cells | 560-12, 38462, 39046, 50768 | Agent modifies cells that should remain untouched or writes outside the target range. | BEHAVIORAL | STRUCTURE |
| 3 | Coverage / Empty Cells | 227-40, 43436, 50768 | Agent leaves target cells empty where values are expected. | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | STRUCTURE |
| 4 | Value Mismatch (Logic Errors) | 51-12, 267-18, 39046 | Agent implements incorrect logic for the task, leading to wrong values. | CAPABILITY-GAP | METHOD |
| 5 | Massive Range Mismatch | 80-42 | Huge gaps in coverage for very large ranges. | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | CONTRACT |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type Mismatch | CONTRACT | guidance.md | Clarified TYPE FIDELITY to forbid string representations of dates/numbers and forbid converting original text to numbers unless requested. | Yes, passing tasks use correct types. |
| Blast Radius | STRUCTURE | prompt.md | Updated Blast Radius Check to forbid overwriting cells with identical content and forbid writing past target range. | Yes, passing tasks only modify targets. |
| Coverage | STRUCTURE | prompt.md | Added "Coverage Check" to Verification Phase to prevent unintended empties in target ranges. | Yes, passing tasks are complete. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- 416-15: wrote `str` instead of `datetime` → now explicitly forbidden from writing string representations of dates.
- 560-12: converted original text to `int` → now warned against converting original text to numbers unless requested.
- 560-12, 38462, 39046, 50768: changed untouched cells → now explicitly forbidden from overwriting cells with identical content.
- 227-40, 43436, 50768: left target cells empty → now requires a "Coverage Check" to ensure all required cells are filled.

## Process & features used
- Parallel diagnosis of trajectories using bash.
- Clustered failures into 5 distinct groups.
- Applied multiple levers: CONTRACT and STRUCTURE.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Literals Only contract (from cand_0001).
- Verification Phase structure (from cand_0001).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- Value Mismatch: Logic errors are often task-specific; focusing on structural/contractual fixes first.
- Massive Range Mismatch (80-42): Only one task affected; lower leverage than systemic behavior.
